title: Azure AI Fundamentals
subtitle: AI-901 · AI concepts, Azure AI services, and Microsoft Foundry
studyContext: I am studying for the Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-901) exam.
citeInstruction: Cite the Microsoft Learn AI-901 skills-measured guide domain where relevant (for example "Domain 2: Implement AI solutions by using Microsoft Foundry"), and name the specific Azure service or Foundry capability.

games.title: Service to Purpose
games.blurb: Match each purpose to the Azure service built for it.

games.title: Feature to Function

games.blurb: Drag each situation — and each Azure safeguard — onto the responsible-AI principle it belongs to.

games.title: Anatomy of an Agent
